201906-1:131.英文: Take, for example, people who are learning to play basketball or the piano, they have to give so much thought and attention to the low-level mechanics of handling the ball, or fingering the keys, or reading the music, that they are unable to give any thought to the thing that matters, the game, or the music, respectively.
201906-1:131.中文: 就拿学打篮球或学弹钢琴的人来说，他们要花大量心思去顾及运球、按键或看谱这些最基础的动作，结果对真正要紧的东西——比赛本身或音乐本身——反倒一点心思都腾不出来。

201906-1:161.英文: In Hong Kong, I’ve seen girls wrapping their whole body or both legs up with a special type of slimming tape, which is supposed to help make them thinner, but it just reminded me of the roasted ham my mother usually puts on the dinner table at Christmas.
201906-1:161.中文: 在香港，我见过女孩子们用一种特殊的减肥胶带缠住全身或两条腿，据说能让人变瘦，可我看了只会想起我妈妈圣诞节常端上餐桌的烤火腿。
